title: Chapter 332: Shanhai City Wins A Great Victory
content:
Chapter 332: Shanhai City Wins A Great Victory

At the same time, Wang Shuo was also wondering, did Zhao Bond have any trump card?

Wang Shuo felt that Bond Zhao was bluffing at this time.

Arif Ubol also felt the same as Wang Shuo, but he didn't dare to bet. If Bond Zhao still had a trump card, then there would be no return for him.

Wang Shuo couldn't figure it out, so he simply ignored it and concentrated on killing the undead around him.

The undead whose strength has been weakened can even be challenged by Wang Shuo against a high-level general.

This exhilarating fighting experience made Wang Shuo feel like he was on a high. The small universe exploded. He only needed one or two sets of combo attacks to kill an undead skeleton at the level of a senior general.

Wuhu, take off!

Not only Wang Shuo felt this way, all the human soldiers felt that they had become stronger.

Of course, this is their illusion, it's just that the enemy has become weaker.

Arif Ubol hesitated again and again, but still did not make up his mind to enter Shanhai City.

"withdraw troops."

Arif Ubol gave an order, and the undead receded like a tide.

The Burning Legion now has one intermediate general, two junior generals, and less than 50,000 undead elite warriors left.

Of course, Zhao Bond will not let go of this good opportunity to pursue victory.

"My fellow soldiers, let's work together to completely defeat the Burning Legion and strengthen our power as a human race!"

"kill!"

"kill!"

"kill!"

…

The horn of counterattack sounded, and the human soldiers rushed out of the city and began to chase the defeated undead army.

Two hours later, the defeated undead army was finally killed, leaving only three generals who escaped with less than a few hundred undead.

So far, the battle has been won.

The surrounding altars, large and small, were all destroyed by various forces.

If it weren't for the fight for the altar, Arif Ubol might have been captured alive.

Wang Shuo also took advantage of the chaos and destroyed the largest altar and several small and medium altars.

Seeing the final victory of the battle, Zhao Bond finally let go of his worries and showed a knowing smile on his face.

In fact, he no longer had any trump cards just now.

If Arif Ubol rushed into Shanhai City, he would have no choice but to fight for his life.

Simply, the other party escaped, which was the best ending.

Killing the opponent's supreme commander is certainly a good thing, but obviously, Shanhai City's army will also suffer heavy losses.

The three county guards had already agreed that whoever wins first will go to support the other two cities.

Being able to retain more vitality is of course the best result.

At the same time, Wang Shuo stood beside the destroyed altar and looked around, seeing a desolate scene.

He couldn't help but want to recite a poem:

The soldiers, carrying their spears astride their horses, were not afraid of the blood-stained battlefield.

The flames of war raged for three thousand miles, with bones everywhere and crows flying everywhere.

…

At this moment, the system prompt sounded.

[The defensive battle of Shanhai City is over. 】

Wang Shuo checked his ranking and ranked second.

Quite satisfied.

[You performed well in this battle, and the Wana Town army made a name for itself. 】

[Reward the reputation of Wana Town +2000, and reward the Red Flame Army’s legion number and flag]

[Reward a Legion Order]

Wang Shuo got a flag and a legion order in his backpack.

When he took it out and saw that it was actually a flag that could increase combat capabilities, the one he made had no attribute bonus. Wang Shuo was overjoyed.

[Red Flame Army Flag: Carrying it in combat can increase the army's attack power by 5%, defense power by 5%, and health by 5%. 】

Wang Shuo was very satisfied that just one military flag could provide such a large increase.

[In this battle, you fought bravely and commanded well, and you will be rewarded with a command value of +10]

At the same time, all human soldiers, whether generals or lower-level soldiers, received corresponding rewards.

Gong Zheng, Ayub and others also had their command points, levels, reputation, etc. improved.

Wang Shuo looked at the items that could be exchanged for military merit points.

In this battle, Varna Town received a total of 12.3 million military merit points.

Among the redeemable items, the first one is a summoning scroll worth 50 million military points.
